definitions.explanation: A retail store that sells books.

examples.japanese: {駅前|えきまえ}に{大|おお}きな{書店|しょてん}がある。
examples.english: There's a large bookstore in front of the station.

examples.japanese: {書店|しょてん}で{新刊|しんかん}を{探|さが}した。
examples.english: I looked for new releases at the bookstore.

examples.japanese: オンライン{書店|しょてん}で{本|ほん}を{注文|ちゅうもん}した。
examples.english: I ordered books from an online bookstore.

notes:
SIMILAR WORDS:
・{本屋|ほんや} - bookstore (casual, everyday term)
・{書店|しょてん} - bookstore (formal term)
・{古本屋|ふるほんや} - used bookstore
・{書籍店|しょせきてん} - bookstore (very formal)

{本屋|ほんや} is more common in conversation, while {書店|しょてん} is used in formal contexts, store names, and written language.

COMMON PATTERNS:
・{書店|しょてん}で{買|か}う (to buy at a bookstore)
・ネット{書店|しょてん}/オンライン{書店|しょてん} (online bookstore)
・{大型|おおがた}{書店|しょてん} (large bookstore)

[Register: Formal]
